fusions.name: Heel Nip
fusions.desc: Nips at the target's heels for 4 damage, leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hackles Up
fusions.desc: Lunges at the target for 28 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold the Yard
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. A hound fights beside you for 8 seconds, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pat on the Head
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 8 stamina. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. Once every 6 seconds.
